confirm.title: Confirm this handover?

confirm.returnLead: Confirming records the odometer on the vehicle profile and closes the booking (Completed). After this the record is read-only.

conflict.title: Someone just edited this record

odometerFix.decreaseTitle: The new reading is lower than the current one
odometerFix.decreaseOverride: I have authority, lower it anyway

handover.photosHint: Photograph the vehicle's condition and odometer to protect your right to compensation if a dispute arises. Optional - you can confirm without it.
handover.evidenceAdvisory: Photograph the vehicle's condition and odometer to protect your right to compensation if a dispute arises.
handover.photosOptional: Optional - you can confirm without it.

confirmDialog.readyBodyPickup: You confirm the vehicle and related documents have been handed over to the customer. Please check the vehicle condition and the required information before confirming.
confirmDialog.nextPickup: After you confirm, the trip status will change to Renting.

handover.returnDepositNotice: With no surcharges, the system proposes refunding the full deposit received. The owner makes the refund outside the app and marks it afterwards - it does not block completing the trip.
handover.odometerBelowPickup: The return odometer ({entered} km) cannot be lower than the pickup odometer ({pickup} km).

occurredAt.hint: {time} - defaults to the scheduled time; adjust it if handover ran late or early.

returnDialog.title: Confirm vehicle returned #{code}
returnDialog.subtitle: Run a quick check and close the trip
returnDialog.loadError: Could not load the handover details for this booking.
returnDialog.earlyBody: The vehicle becomes free on the calendar as soon as you confirm, and other customers can book it. The rental price stays as booked - XePrime does not refund unused days automatically. The customer is notified and can report "I still have the vehicle" if they do.
returnDialog.useScheduledAria: Reset to the scheduled return time ({time})
returnDialog.odoOptional: Optional - leave it blank and the vehicle's mileage stays as is.

returnDialog.mileageSuggestion: {excess} over the limit - suggested excess-mileage fee {amount}
returnDialog.overtimeReason: Returned {late} late - charged {hours, plural, one {# hour} other {# hours}} × {fee}/hour.
returnDialog.refundInfo: You refund the deposit to the customer outside the system, then mark it refunded on the booking's Extra charges card. This does not block closing the trip.
returnDialog.collectHint: Remaining rent plus any charges above the deposit - recorded as a receipt when you confirm.
returnDialog.collectOffHint: The booking will close with {amount} still owed. Collect it later with the Collect payment button on the booking.

returnDialog.suspicious: {delta} over {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} is unusually low (under {threshold}/day). Please double-check the odometer.

The rate depends on the service type (self-drive, long-term, with driver) and applies to the rental, under the tax policy in force for the trip. Companies are not withheld.
